title: 第9章 壕无人性小师妹
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
平常在剑峰待习惯了，林不语对剑峰穷没什么感觉，只要能吃能住就行。

    现在在两位师妹面前，倒显得有些不好意思了。

    “行了行了，我的住所就不用三师兄安排了，你帮找个比较清静，风景好点的地方，我自己来解决。”微生璃月摆摆手。

    她现在的人设好歹是身份尊贵，壕无人性的隐世仙门大小姐，怎么可能会接受住山洞，这与她的人设不符。

    而且自己现在还拖家带口的，总不能让天一天二天三天四几个跟着自己一起受罪，自然是要找个风景好点的地方居住。

    微生璃月戳了戳系统：“统子，系统商城里头有没有什么房子类的法宝，最好是能便宜点，又符合我们现在人设的那种。”

    “我记得应该是有的，阿璃你等等，我去系统库房找找……”

    几分钟后，找到东西的装逼系统兴冲冲的跑回来：“阿璃阿璃，我找到了。当当当当，你看这个，天阶一品豪华版宫殿住房，总共一厅十二殿，由顶级大师耗费无数极品灵石炼制而成。自带聚灵法阵和防御法阵，可防御合体期以下修士攻击，后续可以通过投喂灵石升级法宝，升级资质未知。限时特惠只需要五千装逼值哦！”

    “阿璃，你快点买吧！这个法宝是我特地从系统商城里扒拉回来的，原价要五万装逼值呢，现在算是骨折价了，后期还可以通过灵石升级，买下它稳赚不亏。”

    怕阿璃错过自己好不容易砍价砍回来的好东西，装逼系统着急道。

    “五千装逼值？”

    微生璃月听到这个数字，当即看了一眼自己目前的余额，加上刚刚问心路上获取和扣除的装逼值，现在一共还有5032点。

    要是买下这个宫殿法宝，自己忙碌一天就算白干了。

    可统子说的可升级又挺吸引人，而且它还可以抵御合体期以下修士的攻击，只要买下，她光是龟缩在里头，太虚宗里都没有几人能伤得了自己。

    几番思考之后，微生璃月咬咬牙，买下了这套豪华宫殿。

    装逼值也瞬间扣除，只剩下32点。

    此时林不语已经带着她找到一处比较符合条件的地方，这里是剑峰后山，常年流着一条小瀑布，流水聚集形成的小池塘里种了不少莲花，偶尔还能看到有鱼虾在里面游荡。
content_en:
Lin Buyu was used to staying in Jianfeng, so Lin Buyu had no feelings about being poor in Jianfeng, as long as he could eat and live.

Now in front of the two junior sisters, he seemed a little embarrassed.

"Okay, okay, there is no need for Third Senior Brother to arrange my residence. You can help me find a quieter place with better scenery, and I will take care of it myself." Weisheng Liyue waved her hand.

Her current persona is that of a noble but inhumane reclusive fairy eldest lady. How could she accept living in a cave? This is inconsistent with her persona.

Moreover, I still have a family to take care of, so I can't let four or four of them suffer with me every day, two, and three days. Naturally, I want to find a place with better scenery to live.

Weisheng Liyue poked at the system: "Tongzi, is there any house-type magic weapon in the system mall? It would be better if it is cheaper and in line with our current character design."

"I remember there should be some, Ali, wait a minute, I'll go look for it in the system warehouse..."

A few minutes later, the pretentious system who had found something came back excitedly: "Ali Ali, I found it. Dangdang dangdang, look at this, a first-grade deluxe version of the palace housing, with one hall and twelve halls in total. It was refined by top masters who spent countless high-grade spiritual stones. It comes with a spiritual gathering array and a defensive array, which can defend against attacks by monks below the integration stage. You can upgrade the magic weapon by feeding spiritual stones in the future, and the upgrade qualifications are unknown. A limited-time special offer only requires 5,000 pretentious points!"

"Ali, hurry up and buy it! I specially bought this magic weapon from the system mall. The original price was 50,000 pretentious points, but now it is a broken price. You can also upgrade it through spiritual stones in the future. Buying it will definitely make a profit."

Afraid that Ah Li would miss out on the good stuff that she had finally bargained for, the pretending system said anxiously.

"Five thousand show-off value?"

When Weisheng Liyue heard this number, he immediately took a look at his current balance. Adding in the pretense points he had just obtained and deducted on the Wenxin Road, there were now a total of 5032 points.

If you buy this palace magic weapon, your whole day's work will be in vain.

But what Tongzi said was very attractive as it could be upgraded, and it could resist the attacks of monks below the integration stage. As long as she bought it, she would be able to hide in it, and not many people in the Taixu Sect could hurt her.

After some thought, Weisheng Liyue gritted her teeth and bought this luxurious palace.

The pretense value was instantly deducted, leaving only 32 points.

At this time, Lin Buyu had taken her to find a place that met the conditions. This was the mountain behind Jianfeng Peak. There was a small waterfall flowing all year round. Many lotus flowers were planted in the small pond formed by the water gathering. Occasionally, fish and shrimps could be seen wandering in it.
title_en: Chapter 9 The inhumane little junior sister
